title: Call CQ
description: Call CQ yourself. When a station answers, trade signal reports, names, and locations, then sign off.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.sent: W0TEST DE {MYCALL} UR RST 579 NAME {MYNAME} QTH TEXAS K

lines.speaker: station
lines.sent: {MYCALL} DE W0TEST TNX UR RST {RANDOM_RST} NAME {RANDOM_NAME} QTH {RANDOM_QTH} K

lines.speaker: learner
lines.sent: W0TEST DE {MYCALL} TNX FER QSO 73 SK
